sacrifice time: Many parents are willing to sacrifice time with friends so they can take care of their children.
許多父母願意犧牲和朋友相處的時間，好照顧自己的孩子。
sacrifice quality for speed: A good chef will never sacrifice quality for speed, even when the restaurant is very busy.
好的廚師絕不會為了速度犧牲品質，即使餐廳非常忙碌也一樣。
sacrifice oneself: In the movie, the hero chose to sacrifice himself so that the others could escape safely.
在電影中，英雄選擇犧牲自己，好讓其他人能安全逃走。
make sacrifices: My parents had to make sacrifices, like working two jobs, to send me to a good school.
我爸媽必須做出犧牲，像是兼兩份工作，才能送我去讀好學校。
sacrifice a pawn: In chess, a smart player may sacrifice a pawn in order to win a better position later.
下西洋棋時，聰明的棋手可能會棄兵，以便之後取得更好的局勢。
be saddled with debt: Many college graduates are saddled with debt from student loans for years after they finish school.
許多大學畢業生在畢業後好幾年都背負著學貸債務。
saddle someone with a task: My boss likes to saddle someone with a task on Friday afternoon, just before everyone goes home.
我老闆喜歡在週五下午、大家要下班前，把任務丟給某人。
in the saddle: After months of illness, the CEO is back in the saddle and making important decisions again.
生病好幾個月後，執行長重新掌權，再次做出重要決策。
sail through the exam: She studied hard all semester, so she was able to sail through the exam without any trouble.
她整學期都很用功，所以能毫無困難地輕鬆通過考試。
sail close to the wind: The company sailed close to the wind by selling products that almost broke safety laws.
這家公司冒險行事，販售幾乎違反安全法規的產品。
set sail: The fishing boats set sail early in the morning and came back with lots of fish in the evening.
漁船一大早啟航，傍晚帶著滿滿的魚回來。
plain sailing: Starting my own shop was not all plain sailing; there were many problems in the first year.
開自己的店並不是一帆風順的，第一年就遇到很多問題。
sail into the room: Wearing her new dress, she seemed to sail into the room with a big, confident smile.
她穿著新洋裝，帶著自信的燦爛笑容昂首走進房間。
salvage one's reputation: After the scandal, the actor gave money to charity to try to salvage his reputation.
醜聞爆發後，那位演員捐錢給慈善機構，試圖挽救他的名聲。
salvage the situation: Our team was losing badly, but a great goal in the last minute helped salvage the situation.
我們隊輸得很慘，但最後一分鐘的精彩進球幫忙挽救了局面。
salvage a ship: Divers worked for weeks to salvage a ship that had sunk near the coast with valuable goods.
潛水員花了好幾週的時間，打撈一艘載著貴重貨物、沉在海岸附近的船隻。
salvage what one can: After the flood, the family tried to salvage what they could from their damaged house.
水災過後，這家人試著從受損的房子裡盡量搶救能搶救的東西。
sample the food: When I travel, I love to sample the food at night markets to learn about local life.
旅行時，我很喜歡在夜市試吃食物，來了解當地的生活。
sample local culture: Staying with a host family is a great way to sample local culture and make new friends.
住在寄宿家庭是體驗當地文化和交新朋友的好方法。
sample opinions: Before opening the new park, the city decided to sample opinions from people who live nearby.
在新公園開放之前，市府決定向附近居民抽樣調查意見。
a free sample: The store clerk handed me a free sample of the new shampoo to try at home.
店員遞給我一份新洗髮精的免費試用品，讓我回家試用。
sanction the use of force: The United Nations refused to sanction the use of force against the small country.
聯合國拒絕批准對那個小國使用武力。
impose sanctions: Several countries decided to impose sanctions on the government after it attacked its own people.
在該政府攻擊自己的人民之後，數個國家決定對其實施制裁。
officially sanctioned: The marathon was officially sanctioned by the city, so the main roads were closed that morning.
這場馬拉松獲得市府官方批准，所以那天早上主要道路都封閉了。
satisfy demand: The factory hired more workers to satisfy demand for the popular toy before Christmas.
工廠在聖誕節前雇用更多工人，以滿足這款熱門玩具的需求。
satisfy the requirements: You must satisfy the requirements, such as a good English score, to join the exchange program.
你必須符合要求，例如好的英文成績，才能參加交換學生計畫。
satisfy one's curiosity: To satisfy his curiosity, the boy opened the old box in the attic to see what was inside.
為了滿足他的好奇心，男孩打開閣樓裡的舊箱子，看看裡面有什麼。
satisfy the court: The lawyer had to satisfy the court that his client was at home on the night of the crime.
律師必須使法院信服，他的委託人在案發當晚人在家裡。
satisfy one's hunger: After the long hike, a big bowl of beef noodles was enough to satisfy my hunger.
長途健行之後，一大碗牛肉麵就足以讓我充飢。
